name: bipartite_check
author: 6e31812a
description: Tests whether a graph is bipartite: whether its nodes can be split into two groups so that every edge joins the two groups and no edge lies inside a group. Use it for questions such as 'can these nodes be split into two groups with no links inside a group?', 'is this a two-sided network, like students and projects?' or 'can the nodes be 2-coloured?'. Works on undirected and directed graphs (directions are ignored); weights are ignored. If bipartite, returns the size of each side, up to top_k example nodes per side, and registers each side as a subgraph (result_graph_id is the larger side). If not, returns an odd cycle as proof and registers it as a subgraph (result_graph_id).

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to check, e.g. 'projects' or 'karate'.

top_k.description: How many example nodes to list per side (or of the odd cycle).
